Package dev.relism.flash.ext.security.test

Class FakeSamlIdp

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.security.test.FakeSamlIdp
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class FakeSamlIdp extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A SAML identity provider on a random local port, serving its metadata. Sign-in is approved at once, as signInAs(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>>): respond(java.lang.String) answers the request the application redirected to it with the SAMLResponse a browser would post back.
